judgments.reason: The support span 'Revealed perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates around cystically dilated follicular infundibula' appears literally in the histopathologic examination section of the clinical record, and perifollicular/folliculotropic lymphocytic infiltrates are the hallmark histologic feature of folliculotropic mycosis fungoides, clinically supporting this subtype designation.

The support span 'focal mild follicular mucin deposition' appears literally in the Alcian blue staining findings within the clinical record, and follicular mucin deposition is a recognized histologic feature associated with folliculotropic mycosis fungoides, supporting this subtype modifier.
